production_model: Core fleece made in Los Angeles
notes: About: 'Madhappy is a clothing brand for a community of optimists. Born in Los Angeles, 2017'; formally launched Apr 2017 with hoodies, t-shirts and accessories; runs the Madhappy Foundation for mental-health research and awareness and the Local Optimist magazine.
Stores page: West Hollywood (8906 Melrose Ave), New York (207 Mulberry St), Malibu, East Hampton, Aspen, Costa Mesa (South Coast Plaza), plus Seoul and Tokyo. us_stores true.

FAQ: standard US shipping free over $200 ($5 for $150–$200, $8 for $100–$150, $10 under $100); international free over $250 via a partner, flat $15–$20 below. Ships in 3–7 business days. The market selector lists Canada, United Kingdom and Australia.

FAQ returns: refund or store credit within 30 days of purchase, online or in store; $12 fee deducted from domestic refunds, waived for store credit and exchanges; final sale items excluded; international returns $20, no international exchanges.

Product pages: Classics Fleece Crewneck and Hoodie are 100% cotton heavyweight fleece, relaxed unisex fit, made in Los Angeles; Classic Midweight Fleece Crewneck made in Canada; Polar Fleece Hoodie 100% polyester. Sizes XXS–XXL.

Outside source: https://sites.psu.edu/bkginley/2023/09/13/dairy-boy-brand-analysis/ (student brand analysis, 2023-09-13): 'One brand that I would consider to be their competitor is madhappy', with Madhappy brighter and more abstract, Dairy Boy darker and more neutral.
